title: 10-Min Air Fryer S'mores Lava Dip
hookLine: Toasted campfire marshmallows bubbling over molten milk chocolate ganache in 10 mins.

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {choc_sm} and {marsh_sm} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Melt Chocolate & Toast Marshmallows
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour {choc_sm} into a mini oven-safe skillet, pack {marsh_sm} tightly on top, and air-fry at 360°F (180°C) for 6–7 minutes until toasted golden brown. Scoop with {graham_sm}!
steps.creatorSecret: Add 2 tbsp heavy cream under the chocolate chips so the dip stays scoopable for 20+ minutes.

steps.title: Bake 10-Min Air Fryer S'mores Lava Dip & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 7 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift 10-Min Air Fryer S'mores Lava Dip out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 10 mins.
